none: PAS NLM-953929: Roman Coin: Nummus of Theodora
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [FL MAX THEODORA AVG] ; R/ [PIETAS ROMANA]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Theodora (337-341), Trier mint issue of 337-340, Reece period 17; Sear volume 5 page 121 no. 17499, RIC volume 8 page 145, no. 43. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [FL MAX THEODORA AVG]. Reverse description: Pietas standing facing holding infant. Reverse inscription: [PIETAS ROMANA]. In exergue: TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: 6
